description: This file defines a Java class `RetireSaveHandler` that implements logic to manage the retirement state of objects implementing the `Retireable` interface within the OpenMRS platform. It ensures proper setting or clearing of retirement-related attributes (`retiredBy`, `dateRetired`, `retireReason`) based on the object's retire status during save operations.

classes.name: RetireSaveHandler
classes.description: A handler that manages setting or clearing retirement information on `Retireable` objects during save operations. It implements the logic to fill in retirement metadata when an object is marked as retired and to clear these fields when retired status is unset.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a `Retireable` object during save; sets `retiredBy` and `dateRetired` if object is marked as retired and fields are null, otherwise clears retirement fields if retired is false.
